description.narrative: Ukraine's accession to the Council of Europe in 1995 marked a commitment to democracy, human rights, and the rule of law. However, the Russian Federation's war of aggression against Ukraine has severely disrupted these efforts. In this context, the Verkhovna Rada (Parliament of Ukraine) continues to operate under extraordinary circumstances. The Parliamentary Assembly of the Council of Europe (PACE) plays a vital role in sustaining parliamentary dialogue, fostering democratic resilience, and ensuring Ukraine's continued participation in European parliamentary life. This project supports the Ukrainian delegation's active engagement in PACE activities, reinforcing institutional cooperation and solidarity. The project aims to facilitate the full and active participation of the Ukrainian parliamentary delegation in PACE sessions and related meetings; strengthen parliamentary cooperation and diplomacy between PACE and Verkhovna Rada; enhance Ukraine's representation in PACE committees, networks, and election observation missions; and promote democratic governance, gender equality, and adherence to Council of Europe's standards during wartime and reconstruction.
